title: Good Friday Agreement; devolution laws
note: Devolved government frameworks established for Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

title: Good Friday Agreement
note: Agreement endorsed in referendums creates a framework for peace and power-sharing.

title: Rouble financial crisis
note: Debt default and currency collapse.

title: Clinton impeached
note: House impeaches president; Senate acquits in 1999.

title: Mandela leaves the South African presidency
note: Thabo Mbeki succeeds Mandela after democratic elections.

title: East Timor independence vote
note: UN-backed referendum leads to violence and international intervention.

title: Scottish Parliament and Welsh Assembly open
note: Devolution institutions begin work.

title: Macau handover
note: Portugal transfers administration to China.

title: Euro launched as accounting currency
note: France joins initial euro area before notes and coins arrive in 2002.

title: German government moves back to Berlin
note: Federal parliament and government begin working in reunited capital.

title: Devolution and power-sharing begin
note: Northern Ireland Assembly and Executive take devolved powers in December.

title: Putin becomes prime minister
note: Boris Yeltsin resigns at year’s end, making Putin acting president.

title: NATO Kosovo campaign
note: US participates in NATO air war in Yugoslavia.
